blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: hash function — Maps keys to hash values.
collision — Different keys share a target bucket.
load factor — Filled entries relative to capacity.

blocks.title: Discover
blocks.text: A hash function maps keys to hash values that guide placement/lookups. A collision occurs if distinct keys map to the same location/bucket.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: A.NET Dictionary<TKey,TValue> handles collision management internally; do not equate its actual buckets with simplistic modulo examples.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: To read a missing key safely, use TryGetValue. Hash-table operations are often expected O(1) but poor collisions can degrade performance.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the trace
blocks.text: Both keys collide in bucket 2; a table must resolve collision by chaining or probing.
